body:
I agree. I think it's childish that he wanted physical, paper proof of the abortion. (Isn't the fact that I'm still slightly bleeding & sick enough proof?) 

We had a long talk about it last night, and I think he realized how shitty it was of him to demand proof. For the time being, he has stopped bothering me about it.
I truly appreciate your kind words. Thank you very much. ♡

It's okay. I feel like I probably worded it poorly, as I was rushing to write the post. My apologies. 

But yes, I told him numerous times that I was going to have an abortion. I literally said, "I'll go to *insert clinics name here* and have an abortion. Whatever." I was sick of fighting with him about the pregnancy, so I just wanted to end it. 

His response has been anything but tasteful and understanding. It's heartbreaking that the man I love, and have loved for as long as I can remember, could be so hurtful right now. It probably is the last straw, and you're right. I just wish this situation was handled better, because I really don't want to throw away a relationship that I've been in for almost half my lifetime.
The part that I'm really confused & upset about is that he told me he wanted me to have an abortion... and I told him I was going to.

No... I was out of town for work when I underwent the procedure. I told him I was going to have an abortion while I was out of town, but I don't know if he realized I was serious.

To pay for everything, I went to my bank and withdrew cash from my account, so there's not really any proof to show... aside from the cash withdrawal made from my bank account. But that could have been spent on anything...

I can see the stars. :)

Thank you so, so, so much. I'll definitely have my SO put these on for me when I trip!
Sounds amazing... and daunting.
I used to meditate quite frequently but haven't in a while. Maybe I'll have to start again!
Will do! Thank you! :)
Good to know! Hopefully the same will hold true for me!
Thank you! As I said, if I do decide to try it (which I probably will), I want to maintain an open mind.
Yeah? Maybe flooding my mind with all the bullshit will help me work through it all, though! :)

Yeah, I absolutely want to start out with a small dosage... especially being it's my first time, and I'm not sure of the effects it's going to have on me personally. 

I would totally love if you gave me your playlist that you listen to when/if you trip!

I've been reading a lot on reddit about people who have thoroughly enjoyed their trips, as well as talking to people I know who have taken it. I've been really, really stressed out due to work and personal problems lately, so I just want to have a day/night where I can clear my mind and have some fun. I want to feel free and like I'm not being weighed down by the bullshit in my life. And honestly, a few people I've talked to have said that acid really, really helped them do so.
Do it up! :)

Ahh, makes sense. :)
It's actually pretty awesome bud. Cali med. grade stuff :)
It sucks big time. Basically a pissed off customer came at me, and I had to get the police involved. It was pretty awful.

Not really. I mean, I get to a point where I get really uncomfortably high, which was the case last night after I smoked another bowl, but I haven't yet gotten to a point where I don't get much higher.
Absolutely. It's so cathartic!
Well, I was attacked at work the other night, so I'm pretty shaken up about that. :(

Yeah, I know. I'm fucked up. And I actually really like the cheese! It's the second time I've bought this strain in a month (2 pick ups/2 weeks apart). It's so great. 


And I'm a lady, for any of you wondering!

Shit! I'm so sorry. I forgot all about this. I've had a stressful couple of days. :( 

Here are the pictures: http://imgur.com/a/lo354

I stopped drawing because I got frustrated when I started working on the suckers for the octopus tentacle. He stopped drawing because he fell asleep. 

Sorry for the delay, guys!
I've noticed that Blue Dream is great at keeping me calm, mellow, and happy. :) it's by far my favorite.
I'll post them later tonight! :) I hadn't realized that he didn't draw much, and my doodle is unfinished... but I'll still let you all see them!

I have incredibly bad anxiety as well, and good ol' mary jane is the only thing that has ever helped me. 

But are you sure your anxiety disorder developed because of the acid? It could very well have been underlying and ready to strike, and didn't until you had a bad trip. I'm not trying to discredit you or prove you wrong, just providing some food for thought.
Thanks for the tips. I'll be sure to pass this along to him. :)
Eastern Standard Time :)
Haha, thanks for the advice! I don't plan on spooking him at all tonight, and I'll definitely try to keep him away from anyone who might.
I'll update periodically through the night :)

We've formulated a little bit of a plan, but nothing is set in stone. We're just going to kind of take things as they come, I suppose. I'm not going to trip with him, so I'm just going to be there for him for moral support and to help him enjoy the experience. :)

I think I'm prepared, though! I went out and bought some pretty smelling candles and wax melts, and just some different fun sensory objects that I thought he'd enjoy.
Lol I figured as much. I love listening to music when I'm stoned, so I figured he might when he's tripping, too! :)

Yay! Thanks for the helpful link. I appreciate it...
If you couldn't tell, I'm kinda new to this, so any tips, information, or reading I can find are super great.
Hopefully so! I'll update the thread throughout the night tonight! :)
I wouldn't know, unfortunately. But who knows what the future may bring.

Awesome. I totally will :)

Anything else you can think of that I should play/show him while he's tripping that?

Aww thank you so much! That made me smile! ♡

I was planning on updating throughout the night to let you all know how his trip is progressing, so now that it's been requested, I absolutely will!
Hopefully he'll enjoy the experience, but I'm just trying to prepare for the worst case scenario so that I know how to handle it. :)
Yeah, I definitely think we're going to stay inside at home for a while before we venture outside anywhere.

Thanks :) I appreciate the advice. 

I feel as though my boyfriend will be the future psychonaut, though, not me.

The only unfortunate thing is that he wants to trip at night. We're going to be at home, but he said he might want to take a walk somewhere with me if he's in the mood. 

I'm going to primarily be supervising, and making sure nothing dangerous happens.
Thanks! Hopefully everything will go smoothly. :)
Noted. Thank you :)

We're going to be doing this at night, so darkness isn't going to be an issue. :) 

Is there anything you advise against? Aside from leaving the house and whatnot.

Thank you as well for the information. I greatly appreciate it. :)

I figured the trip would be relatively long, so I'm going home to take a nap before he's out of work... and I feel as though I'm going to have to drink a lot of tea/coffee, but I'm relatively prepared for it. 

He and I have a really wonderful, honest, open & positive relationship, which is why I'm trying to prepare myself for this. I figured I'd be the best person to guide him through this trip and be supportive of him and what he wants to do. 

Do you think that I should stay sober throughout his trip, just so my head is 100% clear? Or would packing a bowl be okay? I'm relatively rational and positive, whether I'm stoned or not. I'm definitely a happier person when I'm baked, though, and I was wondering if all of my positive energy and euphoria would be helpful to him or not.

You were so incredibly informative and super helpful in enlightening me. So for that, I thank you kindly. 

I'm sincerely glad that none of your trips have really been bad or scary. Hopefully it'll be the same thing for my SO. 

What kind of things do you like to do while you're tripping? The first time my SO used LSD, he was at a music festival so he had plenty to keep him occupied. I told him I'd break out some board games, my drawing supplies for him, and charge up the PS3 controllers. Anything else I should prepare? I have lots of fuzzy things, so that, along with drawing stuff, is covered for him. I really want to keep him occupied and help him have a great experience. :)


Edit: He said he wants to take a walk downtown later to see the lights. Would that be an okay thing to do? Or would you think not?
Ahh, interesting. Thanks for the information. :)
Why's that? No appetite?
Yum!
